prompt: Can we add a feature that can translate the CV page into an actual PDF that can contain my information.
output: Added a pdf command and PDF navigation button that assemble the validated CV content into a printable view with public contact links. The Print / Save as PDF action invokes the browser print dialog, while print CSS removes terminal chrome and formats the content for a real PDF export without a client-side PDF dependency. Final validation: 43 Playwright tests passed; Pages artifact, JavaScript, JSON, and whitespace checks passed.
